branding.description: Welcome to the Government Gun Control website, an ever-expanding collection of contemporary information dedicated to the study and understanding of firearms legislation, regulations, rights, and opinions. The archive serves policymakers, scholars, and the public with source-backed material about gun control and firearm culture in America.

hero.title: Welcome to Government Gun Control
hero.intro: A category-driven archive of firearms law, legislation, constitutional rights, politics, ethics, activism, religion, and culture.

posts.title: Latest Posts

about.title: About This Site
about.intro: Government Gun Control preserves and organizes source-backed material about firearms policy, rights, public safety, and American culture.

cards.title: Track public action

cards.title: Keep the archive intact

cards.title: Use a simple static site
